publishedSpecifications.text: This New American country farmhouse offers 2,849 square feet of heated living space with three bedrooms, two-and-a-half baths, and a spacious two-car garage.The welcoming front porch spans 351 square feet, leading into a thoughtfully designed interior featuring ten-foot ceilings on the main level.The open-concept layout centers on a light-filled living area that flows seamlessly into a kitchen equipped with a convenient walk-in pantry.A private primary suite occupies the main floor, providing a tranquil retreat, while two additional bedrooms are positioned to offer comfort and accessibility.The second floor hosts a versatile finished bonus room that serves perfectly as a playroom, dedicated home office, or quiet escape.Outdoor living is enhanced by a generous 499-square-foot covered patio, ideal for relaxing or hosting gatherings in the fresh air.
